t: First scene: The Medical Council ... Already lazy!
Third scene: Should it really go on like this?
d: Spacious, but meagerly furnished studio. Behind Entréetür. in the middle a podium. Between the podium and Entréetür a Spanish wall. Front, on one side an easel with the not yet fully executed picture Lulus. On the other side an ottoman. Above a tiger fur. In the background a stepladder and a plastic.

Very elegant salon. Back entrance door. Portièren on the right and left. To the left a few steps lead into the studio. On a wall above the fireplace in magnificent brocade frame Lulu's picture as Pierrot. Front left a chaise longue. On the right a desk. In the middle a few armchairs around a table.

On the left back the door, on the right back a Spanish wall. In the middle, with the narrow side against the spectators, a long table, on the dance costumes lie. On the right and left from the table a chair. On the left front table with armchair. On the right front a high mirror, next to it a high, very wide, old-fashioned arm chair. In front of the mirror a stool, make-up box etc. .... - On the back wall a large poster, which can be seen despite inscription etc. as a copy of the portrait of Lulus from the previous scene. Behind the scene dance music.
Long-lasting, strongly dampened gossip and bravorufing becomes audible from the outside.

Magnificent hall in German renaissance with heavy plafond in carved oak wood. - The walls up to half height in wooden sculptures. Above on both sides faded Gobelins. To the rear the hall is completed by a gallery, which is imposed by a curtain, but which is semi-open at the beginning of the scene. From this gallery leads left a monumental staircase down to half depth of the stage. In the middle under the gallery the entrance door with twisted columns and frontispiece. On the right side wall a spacious high fireplace. Further on in front a balcony window with closed heavy curtains. On the left side in front of the stairwell a closed portière in Genoese velvet. In front of the fireplace stands a Chinese folding wall as a screen. In front of the foot-post of the free stair railing, on a decorative relay egg, Lulu's image as a pier red in antiquised gold frame. On the left front is a wide ottomane, on the right in front a fauteuil.

Hall as before The gallery is completely imposed, as is the balcony window on the right (heavy curtains) and the portière on the left. The fauteuil is standing on the left, next to it a serving table. The easel is empty; the picture of Lulu is leaning upside down against the fireplace. The hall is illuminated only by a floor lamp standing on the middle table, deeply veiled. Also otherwise a matteness, dustiness, uninhabitedness of the room, which is artificially closed against the daylight outside. On the serving table coffee maker, coffee bowl and liqueur.
